title: KHALM-VMR demo: software environment
statement: The software the KHALM-VMR demo record names by this file's SHA-256, as learning_provenance.training_environment.software_hash (docs/demo/record-manifest.json). Each value is copied from the repository file its source names. The document names software by version only: it is not a measurement of any build, and it names no compiler, CUDA toolkit or machine. Of the record's other training_environment members, training_software states engine_library's version, hardware_id and tee_measurement are empty (none is claimed), and accelerator_software is illustrative: the demo trains nothing, and engine builds made with different CUDA toolkits emit the same demo record.

engine_library.name: khalm_tlm
engine_library.source: CMakeLists.txt, the lines "project(khalm_tlm" and "VERSION 0.1.0" of its project() call

rust.source: vmr/Cargo.toml, [workspace.package] rust-version; the repository pins no Rust toolchain
